shared_elements: horizontal band/register of repeated motifs running along the top
row of animals aligned along a common baseline
animal heads in profile with prominent muzzle
justification: Both are stone reliefs organised in horizontal registers, with a repeated band of small motifs along the upper edge and profile quadrupeds standing on a common groundline alongside upright figures. The manner of execution differs sharply: A is a shallow, schematic, weathered carving with stacked and overlapping creatures on a rough pillar, while B is a smoothly modelled, near-naturalistic frieze with careful anatomy, drapery detail and precise rosette borders on dressed panels.
